name: Seated Knee Tuck
steps: Sit on the edge of a bench or mat, hands holding the sides behind you.
Lean back slightly and stretch your legs out, feet off the floor.
Breathe out and pull your knees toward your chest as your chest comes forward.
Pause, then extend the legs back out with control.
cues: Knees and chest meet in the middle

common_mistakes.fix: Keep the chest open and back long
Lean back only as far as you can hold steadily
Extend the legs slowly each rep
